case_number: 2023 INSC 149; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 5328-5329 OF 2016 AND OTHERS
summary: Environmental protection vs property rights; dispute over construction permissions near Teliya Talab water body; NGT orders prohibiting construction on grounds of submergence area; review petitions dismissed by NGT; reliance on Collector's report demarcating Maximum Water Level; prior litigation established res judicata on land ownership; conflict between environmental regulations and final judicial decisions; consideration of development plan approved in 2003; challenge to NGT's jurisdiction to override civil court decrees; doctrine of finality of judgment invoked; determination of water body boundaries and construction permissions.
legal_provisions_cited: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act 1974
final_judgment: Special leave granted; appeals heard finally; NGT's orders challenged regarding construction permissions near Teliya Talab; matter likely set aside or modified to respect prior judicial decrees while considering environmental protection concerns.
